AppListing.title: AppListing
AppListing.description: A published or draft software or game listing uploaded by a registered developer in PulseStore.

developerId.description: UID of the developer who owns and manages this software listing.

developerName.description: Public studio or developer display name.

title.description: Display title of the app or game (2-50 chars).

tagline.description: Short marketing subtitle shown in storefront cards (4-120 chars).

description.description: Detailed app description and feature overview (10-2000 chars).

appType.description: Primary storefront section: game or app.

sizeMb.description: Estimated package size in megabytes (1 to 4096).

accentColorHex.description: Hex brand color for the app tile badge (#RRGGBB).

iconPreset.description: Vector icon preset identifier for the app badge.

iconUrl.description: Optional HTTPS image URL for custom app artwork.

downloadUrl.description: Optional HTTPS release distribution or project web URL.

releaseNotes.description: What's new notes for the current version.

published.description: Whether the listing is publicly visible in the store catalog.

starterCatalog.description: Marks initial storefront showcase entries separate from personal studio builds.

ratingSum.description: Sum of all user star ratings (1-5).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when listing was created (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest listing update (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DeveloperProfile.title: DeveloperProfile
DeveloperProfile.description: Public developer studio profile containing non-PII branding information.

studioName.description: Public developer or studio name (2-60 chars).

specialty.description: Primary craft focus such as Indie Games or Productivity Tools.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when developer profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when developer profile was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PrivateDeveloperAccount.title: PrivateDeveloperAccount
PrivateDeveloperAccount.description: Private developer account configuration containing contact PII, strictly restricted to the owning user.

termsAccepted.description: Confirmation that developer distribution guidelines were accepted.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when developer account was registered (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

InstalledApp.title: InstalledApp
InstalledApp.description: Record of a game or application downloaded to a user's personal PulseStore library.

title.description: Snapshot title of the installed app.

installedVersion.description: Version currently installed in user library.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest version update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AppReview.title: AppReview
AppReview.description: User-submitted star rating and review for a published software listing.

authorName.description: Display name of the review author.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when review was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when review was edited (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/apps/{appId}.description: Public catalog of published apps and games plus private drafts readable by their developer.

/apps/{appId}/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Per-app user ratings and reviews keyed by reviewer UID.

/developer_profiles/{userId}.description: Public studio branding profiles without PII.

/developers/{userId}.description: Private developer account settings and contact PII isolated strictly to the owner.

/users/{userId}/library/{appId}.description: Authenticated user's personal downloaded and installed software library.
